roles.describe: The human. Holds everything, and is the only role whose credential never enters the dev container.
roles.name: operator

ops.describe: Read the knowledge base: tasks, items, namespaces, views, history, designs, workflows, roles, timelines, leases, removals and its own run requests; and bind an attested agent to its task.
ops.name: read

ops.describe: Send what every agent's hooks send: notifications, the session registry, and messages on the queue.
ops.name: hook

ops.describe: Add tasks and change their text, fields, tags, dependencies, placement and bindings; record a task's worktree location and its pull request; ingest text; write investigations.
ops.name: task_write

ops.describe: Set a task's status directly, past its workflow.
ops.name: task_status

ops.describe: Claim, start, take, abandon or release work; take and release a repo's land lease; queue, archive, cancel and drop worktree removals.
ops.name: task_claim

ops.describe: File and record a review round.
ops.name: review

ops.describe: Land a task's branch, check whether it may land, record a landing and close tasks merged elsewhere, where the task's strategy lets the role.
ops.name: land

ops.describe: Fire or observe workflow events, each as the task's strategy allows.
ops.name: workflow

ops.describe: Write design documents: create, move, split, edit and stage them and their parts, apply changes, reply to threads, and record plans, prompts, targets and sources.
ops.name: design

ops.describe: Approve a part of a design, when it names this reviewer.
ops.name: design_approve

ops.describe: Hand out and revoke role grants, of the roles it may grant.
ops.name: grant

ops.describe: Vouch for which agent made a tool call: the dev container's credential alone.
ops.name: attest

ops.describe: Ask the operator to run one command.
ops.name: exec_request

ops.describe: The operator's own: choose and define strategies, edit agent templates, map agent types, rotate the container credential, reclaim work, break leases, waive reviews, record what ran on the host, remove items, move namespaces, compact the queue and designs, start and resolve design threads, approve selections, retire and restore designs, and approve, decline, refuse, run and finish run requests.
